subject: Vendor onboarding: PO threshold amendment request
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@quickvendor.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QuickVendor onboarding & PO question

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the fast intro last week. We're excited to kick off the pilot with Redwood — the engineering team is ready to start ingesting sample data next week. Before we move forward with billing, I wanted to clarify your PO policy. Our early-stage customers typically run on invoices for the first 30 days while we finish integration. Can QuickVendor be onboarded without an immediate PO for the pilot?

Attached: quickvendor_onboarding_form.pdf (vendor intake form)
Also attaching our W-9 to speed procurement: quickvendor_tax_w9.pdf

If a short-term no-PO path is possible, what documentation or limits do you require? Alternately, we can have a PO issued if that's easier — just want to know the fastest route so we hit the integration timeline.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Head of Ops, QuickVendor Inc.
maya@quickvendor.io
+1 415-555-0132

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@quickvendor.io>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuickVendor onboarding & PO question

Hi Maya — appreciate the attachments and the clear timeline.

Quick summary of Redwood's standard approach: production suppliers normally require an issued PO prior to invoicing. However, for short pilots we do have a provisional no-PO path with guardrails: temporary allowance for up to 3 invoices or $5,000 total (whichever comes first), evidence of W-9, a signed provisional agreement, and a single billing contact + purchase-email for reconciliation.

I'm looping in Priya from procurement and Laura from operations to advise on whether QuickVendor fits the provisional criteria and what documentation we'll need to formalize.

Action items for Maya:
- Confirm the expected cadence & estimate for the first three invoices (approx amounts/dates)
- Confirm billing contact and legal name for the invoice
- Sign the provisional no-PO form (Priya will share)

Subject: Re: QuickVendor onboarding & PO question — provisional approval checklist

Hi all,

Thanks for the details, Jasmine. I reviewed the intake form and W-9. QuickVendor looks low risk from a payments perspective (US entity, standard W-9 provided). To proceed with a provisional no-PO onboarding we require the following:

1) QuickVendor to sign the attached provisional_no_po_agreement.pdf (limited to pilot period)
2) A named billing contact and email for invoice receipt/reconciliation
3) A short estimate of the three pilot invoices (ceiling not to exceed $5,000 total)
4) Agreement to Net30 terms and Redwood's standard pilot SOW language (we can attach an SOW template if helpful)

Mitigations we will apply during the provisional period:
- Finance will perform expedited invoice checks and block repeat work if invoices exceed stated estimates
- Temporary flag in vendor record indicating "provisional no-PO" with a 90-day review window

If Maya can return the signed provisional agreement and the invoice estimates today, I can route this to Finance for a quick authorization. CCing Laura to ensure the operational onboarding (SFTP creds / config) aligns with the billing timeline.

Attachments: provisional_no_po_agreement.pdf

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: QuickVendor onboarding & PO question — next steps

Hi Maya — thanks for the quick turnaround on the W-9. Per Priya's checklist, the provisional agreement will be the formal step.

Proposed next steps (agreed by Procurement):
- Maya to sign and return provisional_no_po_agreement.pdf (DocuSign link below) — this limits the pilot to three invoices / $5,000 total
- QuickVendor to provide invoice estimates and billing contact by EOD (maya@quickvendor.io is fine)
- Once signed, Markus (Finance) will perform a one-time approval to enable the temporary flag in our AP system; Laura will stage onboarding credentials the same day.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://docusign.redwood.company/QVID-2027-097/provisional
